title: Richard Foch saw vault documents dating gravity control to October 1954
summary: Steven Greer tells of Richard Foch saw vault documents dating gravity control to October 1954, about 1945-1954 at Naval Research Laboratory, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Rick had been in the vault and saw the documents for the date we mastered gravity control and it was October 1954.
Well, it's just from what um Greer has alleged one of his teammates that was in a vault that saw the documents that talked about gaining that kind of control.
tellings.difference: Told secondhand through Greer, without naming Foch or giving the month.
tellings.link_reason: Greer's teammate in a vault saw documents dating gravity control to 1954. This is the Richard Foch vault story.

as_told.title: Gravity control achieved in 1954, seen in vault documents

plain: A UFO researcher, Steven Greer, passes on what a man named Richard "Rick" Foch told him, in a story tied to the Naval Research Laboratory, the US Navy's research lab. Greer says Foch had been inside a secure vault and saw documents giving the date the United States mastered gravity control: October 1954. If true, it would mean secret technology to defy gravity has existed for about seventy years.
